purpose: calculate immutable typed standing and uncertainty from real witnessed matchups without turning defaults counts source classes or query rankings into permanent truth

coordinate_key: language and modality scope when applicable
state.publication: append immutable successor epochs; never rewrite prior state or source testimony

defaults.numeric_values: declared by each accepted arena; this contract does not invent them
defaults.use: initialize one previously unseen exact standing coordinate
defaults.new_participant_state: publish an immutable zero-match default state before or atomically with the first admissible matchup
defaults.subsequent_state: consume the immediately preceding completely published state for that coordinate
prohibitions: replace earned participant standing with source-type prior
reuse standing from another arena merely because content identity is equal

required_fields: eligible evidence roots and dependence closure
matchup.creation_rule: a declared recipe must prove that the outcome tests the exact proposition operation interpretation or realization being rated
matchup.opponent_rule: use the opponent's prior rating and deviation when available; use the typed default only for an unseen opponent coordinate
matchup.dependence_rule: match cardinality is calculated after eligible root collapse; copied or derived descendants do not manufacture games

outcomes.rating_rule: only outcome kinds explicitly admitted by the arena recipe are mapped to Glicko-2 scores

return_leg.rule: after an independently supported later boundary evaluates a proposition or operation, eligible prior participants may play a return-leg matchup against that outcome
return_leg.epoch_separation: a participant cannot use consensus it helped create as independent evidence of its own reliability in the same epoch
return_leg.source_type_prior: remains separately queryable and may initialize a source coordinate but cannot replace earned source standing

rating_period.order: deterministic and invariant to ingestion order for the same boundary
rating_period.replay: idempotent; the same event identity cannot increment matchup count twice
rating_period.missing_state: return a typed why-not result rather than substitute a flat score or unrelated default
rating_period.as_of: historical queries select an immutable standing epoch; current queries select the latest completely published eligible epoch

forbidden: flat replacement for typed evidence dimensions

realization.language_capability: a witnessed set of identification interpretation semantic-act realization reconstruction correction and consequence capabilities, not a boolean flag
realization.competition_scope: nouns function words particles punctuation whitespace morphology word order prosody and code syntax compete only under the typed obligations they can satisfy
realization.result_binding: an observed rendering outcome updates only the responsible realizer grammar operator or firmware route and only for distinctions the outcome actually tested

deliberate_defects: source-type literal permanently replaces source standing
raw witness count becomes game count
standing leaks across arenas contexts languages modalities or time
whole event success updates unrelated outputs
nouns permanently outrank function words or punctuation
